summary: First test run for Benita ERP. Backend: 5/5 pytest pass (root, status create+list, ai/insights default/te/empty). Frontend: login + role auto-fill + admin/staff/parent dashboards + sidebar nav (students/finance/communication/crm) + admission wizard + announcements + tickets + logout + demo-mode banner all working. data-testid coverage is solid (login-email, login-password, login-submit-btn, role-btn-admin/staff/parent, nav-*, stat-* x5 on admin, parent-module-* x10, adm-input-*, adm-next-btn, ann-*, ticket-*).

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer logs warning 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Likely transient race during initial render or missing minWidth/minHeight on the chart wrapper. Cosmetic only — chart eventually renders.

action_items: (Optional) Set explicit minWidth/minHeight or aspect on the revenue ResponsiveContainer in Dashboard.jsx to silence Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: AI insights JSON parsing only accepts >=3 array items; 1-2 items fall back silently. Acceptable but consider padding from fallback to keep partially-generated content.
server.py: status_checks GET reads up to 1000 docs without pagination; fine for demo, add pagination/limit param for production.
Frontend env: REACT_APP_FIREBASE_* keys are intentionally blank (Demo Mode). Banner correctly informs user. Document this clearly in README for prod deployment.
test_credentials: admin@demo.school / demo1234, staff@demo.school / demo1234, parent@demo.school / demo1234 (all working via DEMO_USERS in AuthContext)
seed_data_creation: None — frontend uses pre-seeded demoStore (students, employees, transactions, tickets, announcements). Backend test inserted one TEST_pytest_client status_check row in MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py — re-run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Frontend tested against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL preview host. AI insights endpoint succeeds via Emergent LLM key (gemini-3-flash-preview) and falls back gracefully. Demo Mode is the expected default — Firebase blank env keys are intentional. Parent module tiles render after a short delay; allow ~2s wait_for_timeout after navigating to /dashboard/parent-dashboard before querying parent-module-* selectors.
rca of the issue: No bugs — all features verified working as per review_request.
